scale.zero: First scene (sequence ordinal; not elapsed time)

events.title: Down the Rabbit-Hole
events.note: Alice leaves her sister to follow a White Rabbit, falls down a deep well, and finds a locked hall with a small door into a beautiful garden. A drink makes her too small to reach the key; a cake begins another change in size.

events.title: The Pool of Tears
events.note: Alice grows enormously and cries a pool of tears, then shrinks while fanning herself with the Rabbit's fan. She swims with a Mouse and other creatures, alarming the Mouse with talk of her cat and a dog.

events.title: A Caucus-Race and a Long Tale
events.note: The wet company tries to dry itself with the Mouse's history lesson and the Dodo's Caucus-race. Alice gives out comfits and receives her own thimble as a prize. The Mouse leaves after a misunderstanding, and Alice's praise of Dinah scatters the birds.
